SBI Bank Trade Finance Officer TFO Online Form 2026 – Extend – Full Details

State Bank of India (SBI) has released the notification for the post of Trade Finance Officer. This recruitment has been issued for 35 posts. Online applying process for SBI Bank Trade Finance Officer Recruitment 2026 has started on 29 August 2026 & the candidates can apply till 28 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for SBI Bank Trade Finance Officer TFO Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 August 2026
  • Last Date : 28 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 September 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 750/-
  • SC, ST, PH : 0/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
